scope: Private archived v9 tiny-model diagnostic only; no v10, throughput or deployment claim.
rule: Four distinct prompts, cache_prompt=false, greedy, one server and slot. Require HTTP 200, slot 0, caps 7/0/8/8 and positive draft_n for nonzero cases. Zero case requires explicit zero or archived-v9 binary/library and loaded-map proof plus source-verified serialization: n_draft_total reset to 0 each slot, incremented by nonnegative draft.size, nonzero transferred to timing and serialized only when positive. Any missing source/binary linkage, response, slot continuity or positive controls makes zero unknown. No interrupted exposed request is redrawn as part of a resumed sequence. Dry-run is a separate control exposure and cannot support full verdict.
